title: Sign-in and sessions, hardened
steps: This Preview signs you in as a dev user, so Google sign-in itself is tested in test/google.test.ts. What you can try here is signing out.

Run Sign out from the command bar (⌘⇧P). You get "Signed out", and in DevTools > Application the IndexedDB database, Cache Storage and the service worker are gone. Loading the app again signs you back in as the dev user.
Open <this Preview>/auth/sign-out from a link on another site: you get a Sign out button instead, and nothing is cleared until you press it.
